approach.title: 1. Our Approach
approach.body: We use the smallest set of browser storage that lets the site work correctly. We do not run advertising networks or cross-site tracking pixels on this website.

whatWeStore.title: 2. What We Store
items: Essential session storage — maintains login and form protection.
Language preference — remembers your chosen site language.
Anonymous article counter — uses a random identifier for single-browser counting.

analytics.title: 3. Analytics
analytics.body: Article view counting is anonymous: it records a random local identifier, the article and the language, with no name, email or advertising identifier attached. It cannot be used to identify you.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-Party Storage
thirdParty.body: Our infrastructure providers may set strictly necessary cookies for security, session integrity and abuse prevention. If you follow a link to an external site, that site’s own cookie policy applies.

controlling.title: 5. Controlling Storage
items: Your browser’s privacy settings let you view, block or delete stored cookies and site data at any time.
Blocking essential storage may prevent parts of the site, such as forms or the AI assistant, from working correctly.
Clearing site data resets your language preference and any local assistant state.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.bodyPrefix: For questions about browser storage on this site, contact
